source_title: Avengers: Doomsday Announces New Crossover, Watch Video: ‘We’re Just Getting Started…’
source_excerpt:
Home » Avengers: Doomsday Announces New Crossover, Watch Video: ‘We’re Just Getting Started…’
MCU fans are getting a surprising Avengers: Doomsday collaboration with a popular fast-food brand. It will introduce special superhero-inspired treats ahead of the film’s release.
Burger King India’s official Instagram account recently posted a brief clip. Styled like Doomsday’s cast announcement, the video featured different chairs lined up together. Instead of actors’ names, the chairs revealed different menu items for Indian fans.
The post read, “Two universes. One epic collaboration. Burger King India is joining forces with Avengers Doomsday for something BIG. And trust us, this is just the beginning. Stay tuned. We’re just getting started…”
The Avengers: Doomsday collaboration brings Marvel-inspired surprises to the menu
As part of the collaboration, Burger King will introduce a menu inspired by iconic MCU heroes for Avengers: Doomsday fans in India. The confirmed items include the Doomsday Whopper, Magneto Crunchy Chicken Burger, Shuri Vibranium Fries, Thor Thunder Nuggets, and Fantastic Fizz. More items may be announced soon.
The latest crossover comes days after Marvel announced a similar partnership with Jack in the Box. Starting November 5, 2026, fans will be able to order the Doomsday Dipping Box. The box will include unique sauces and snacks inspired by the film’s iconic and returning superheroes.
Each box will also feature a randomly selected magnet inside a blind bag. Fans can then collect all eight magnets to assemble a team of Doomsday characters. Speaking to People , a spokesperson from Jack in the Box revealed, “We’re unleashing that spirit in the Doomsday Dipping Box, a larger-than-life expression of what happens when epic fandom meets unmissable food moments.”
Directed by Joe and Anthony Russo, Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters on December 18, 2026. The film features a massive cast, including Robert Downey Jr. as Victor von Doom, alongside Chris Hemsworth as Thor, Vanessa Kirby as Sue Storm/Invisible Woman, Pedro Pascal as Reed Richards/Mr. Fantastic, Anthony Mackie as Sam Wilson/Captain America, and more.
